subject: Request: Reissue credit memo with VAT breakdown and supporting tax evidence
messages:
From: ClearFront AP <ap@clearfront.com>
To: priy a <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Credit memo reissue request - VAT breakdown needed

Hi Priya,

We received the credit memo you issued against INV-45321 but our accounting team flagged that the memo does not include a VAT breakdown or our VAT registration number. Without that detail our AP cannot apply the credit against the outstanding VAT in our local ledgers.

Can you reissue the credit memo showing gross and VAT lines and add our VAT registration (EU: GB123456789) on the document? Also please stamp the memo with the original invoice reference (INV-45321) and the credit memo number so we can process it.

Attached is a copy of the invoice we matched it to for reference.

Thanks,
Laura Gibbs
Finance Manager
ClearFront Technologies
Attachment: invoice_INV-45321.pdf (PDF, 210 KB)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Gibbs <laura.gibbs@clearfront.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Credit memo reissue request - VAT breakdown needed

Hi Laura — thanks for the quick flag.

We can reissue a credit memo that includes: net amount, VAT amount (by rate), your VAT registration number, and a clear reference to INV-45321. To do that we just need either a scanned VAT certificate or confirmation of the VAT registration number you want printed on the document. If any withholding tax applies on your side, let us know so we can add a note.

Ben and Marissa, looping you in for accounting to generate the new PDF and confirm this will post against the same invoice. Targeting 3 business days for the reissue once we have the confirmation.

Laura — do you confirm the VAT number to use is GB123456789 and can you attach the certificate?

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0123

Hi Priya,

Confirmed — please use VAT reg number GB123456789. I have attached our VAT certificate for your records.

One additional ask: can the credit memo explicitly show the tax rate applied (20%) and the VAT amount per line? Our AP needs the line-level breakdown for the VAT reclaim process. Also, please indicate the credit is being issued as a contra to INV-45321 (PO: CF-PO-7789).

Regarding withholding tax — we do not apply withholding on credits to Redwood.

Attachment: ClearFront_VAT_certificate.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)

Thanks,
Laura
